attributes.title: AAACN 2027 Annual Conference
attributes.cme_provider: American Academy of Ambulatory Care Nursing (AAACN)
attributes.organizer: American Academy of Ambulatory Care Nursing
attributes.summary:
The 52nd AAACN Annual Conference for ambulatory care nurses runs April 27 to 30, 2027, at the New Orleans Marriott. The four-day schedule includes a pre-conference workshop, and there is no live stream; recordings are sold as a PostCon Online Access package.

In-person attendees can earn up to 20 ANCC contact hours, the on-demand package up to 15. Members pay $715 through February 26, 2027, and $815 after; non-members pay $795 or $895. The conference hotel rate of $259 a night is available through March 29, 2027. Future conferences are set for Honolulu (2028), Philadelphia (2029) and Louisville (2030).
